en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from one of his companion, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a man who entered into Al-Islam, so he drank the wine, and he was ignorant. Heasws said: ‘Iasws would not happen to be the one who establishes the Penalty (Hadd) upon him, when he was ignorant, but Iasws would inform him with that, and teach him. So if he were to repeat, Iasws would establish the Penalty (Hadd) upon him’.
